2. Added `kfree(hostcmd);` before returning `-ENOMEM` when `cfg80211_testmode_alloc_reply_skb` fails. This prevents memory leakage if the allocation for `skb` fails.
3. Added `kfree(hostcmd);` before returning `-EMSGSIZE` when `nla_put` fails. This ensures that the memory allocated for `hostcmd` is freed if there is an error in putting the data into the socket buffer.

### Relationships Between Modifications
The modifications are all related to memory management for the `hostcmd` variable. The patch addresses potential memory leaks by ensuring that any allocated memory for `hostcmd` is properly freed in all error handling paths of the `mwifiex_tm_cmd` function. This is crucial for maintaining system stability and preventing resource exhaustion in the driver. Each modification is strategically placed to handle specific error conditions, ensuring that the memory is released before the function exits in case of failure.
